t: You're looking at Central Saint Giles, a mixed-use development of two buildings, up to fifteen storeys high, around a public courtyard of shops and restaurants. Its façades are covered in 134,000 glazed tiles in orange, red, lime green and warm yellow. It was completed in May 2010 and cost £450 million. It was designed by Renzo Piano, and it is his first work in the UK. Piano also designed the Pompidou Centre in Paris and The Shard, and he won the Pritzker Prize in 1998.
